images.alt: Faceted swallows flying in a widening formation along a satin ribbon current.
images.source: Editorial illustration on a soft Daylight sky, nearly square, safe to crop to 4:5. A flock of swallows built from flat paper facets in Partner Navy and slate blue flies in a widening V formation along a satin ribbon current that sweeps from the lower left to the upper right in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan. Three birds lead at the lower left and the formation grows to many birds toward the upper right, every bird holding its place: AI growing across a whole company, with one team flying together. Below, low faceted hills at daybreak in pale blues. Calm open sky in the upper left quarter. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

content.heading: Everything it takes to scale AI.
content.lead: Strategy, training, software, operations, robotics and people. Start with the part you need most and add the rest over time.

items.title: AI strategy and roadmap
items.text: We find where AI can save or make the most money, then plan what to do first.

items.title: AI check-up
items.text: Our usual first project: a short review of where AI could save you time or money.

items.title: Fractional Chief AI Officer
items.text: An experienced AI leader who works with your leadership team part time.

items.title: AI governance and compliance
items.text: Clear AI policies, and help following AI laws such as the EU AI Act.

items.title: AI training and workshops
items.text: Hands-on sessions that teach your team to use AI in their daily work.

items.title: AI assistant rollout
items.text: We set up ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or Gemini across your company, with the right security settings.

items.title: AI in tools you already pay for
items.text: Many tools, like Salesforce and HubSpot, include AI features. We turn them on and set them up properly.

items.title: AI software engineering and web development
items.text: Custom software and websites with AI built in.

items.title: MVPs and prototypes
items.text: A working first version of a new product, ready to test with real users.

items.title: Mobile apps
items.text: iPhone and Android apps with AI features.

items.title: AI features for your product
items.text: We add AI to software you already have, such as smart search or an in-app assistant.

items.title: SaaS products
items.text: We build and launch subscription software with AI at its core.

items.title: Fixing AI-built apps
items.text: Apps built quickly with AI coding tools, made secure and stable enough for real customers.

items.title: Legacy system updates
items.text: We use AI to speed up rewriting and updating old systems.

items.title: AI connectors (MCP)
items.text: Your company’s tools, connected to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude so they can look things up and take actions safely.

items.title: AI-as-a-Service
items.text: We build AI tools and run them for you on a subscription.

items.title: Managed AI operations
items.text: We monitor your AI systems and agents and keep their costs in check.

items.title: Private AI
items.text: AI models that run on your own servers or private cloud, so sensitive data stays in-house.

items.title: Custom model training
items.text: AI models trained on your own data, so they understand your business.

items.title: AI testing and quality checks
items.text: Accuracy testing before and after launch, so you can rely on the answers.

items.title: AI robotics
items.text: We bring AI into robots and machines so they can handle more tasks on their own.

items.title: Computer vision
items.text: Cameras and AI that check product quality or spot safety risks.

items.title: Predictive maintenance
items.text: Sensors and AI that warn you before a machine breaks down.

items.title: Warehouse and logistics automation
items.text: AI and robots that speed up picking and packing.

items.title: Digital twins
items.text: A live virtual model of a factory or process, for testing changes before making them for real.

items.title: Agency services
items.text: We take on whole projects as your agency, from planning to launch.

items.title: Embedded developers (developer staffing)
items.text: Our developers join your team and work inside it, with all of Alliance AI Partners behind them.

items.title: Dedicated AI teams
items.text: A full team of engineers, designers, and a project lead, working only on your product.

items.title: AI-powered virtual assistants
items.text: A trained assistant who uses AI tools to manage your inbox, calendar, and research.

items.title: White-label services for agencies
items.text: We deliver AI projects under your agency’s brand, so you can offer AI without hiring.

sections.name: How it runs
sections.job: Show how a Scale AI engagement runs in four steps, and what the partner sees every month.
sections.desktop: Navy chapter. Asymmetric head (Heading/1), the Steps component with Scale AI wording, then a split: text and check list left 560, the framed monthly report preview right (640x480, top of the email).
sections.mobile: Head stacked, Steps (mobile variant), text and list, then the report preview re-cropped to 4:5 with its caption.

content.heading: Start small. Scale what works.
content.lead: Every engagement follows the same four steps. The first project is small, so you can judge the work before you commit to more. A person reviews every piece of work.

items.title: Understand
items.text: We learn how each team works and where AI could save the most time or money.

items.title: Plan
items.text: We agree what success looks like, using your own numbers, and pick what to do first.

items.title: Build
items.text: We build the tools, set up the AI you already pay for and train your people to use it.

items.title: Run and grow
items.text: We keep it running, keep costs in check and add the next project when you’re ready.

body: You see progress every week, and every month a written report: what shipped, what changed, what AI usage cost and the plan for next month.
AI usage passed on at cost, with each provider’s usage report attached.
Monthly plans you can cancel with [30] days’ notice.
